description: Cmd KSearch. Part of the Cmdk APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint).

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20.

refresh.description: When true, bypass cache and recompute. Default: false.

isMobile.description: Is mobile query parameter. Default: false.
